BiblicalUsage: Temeni is an Israelite named in the genealogy of Judah. In 1 Chronicles 4:6, Temeni, and Haahashtari. These were the sons of Naarah.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Temeni matters because God works through ordinary people, and no name in His book is there by accident.
